description: Night 29 (2026-10-28; Dr. Luitel, 2026-10-21: try my own LIF/Transformer on top of the pretrained model and see what is best): the confirmation of the pool head on WavLM Large's layer-20 frames. The two configurations of heads27_pool with the highest mean validation UA over its 5 folds and seeds 1 to 3, each exactly as the screen ran it: rank 1, random 8: model.pooling="stats", model.classifier_hidden=128, model.dropout=0.1, features.normalization="utterance", augment.time_masks=4, augment.time_mask_width=20, train.class_balance="none" (bbacadb895ca, 0.7847), as the base, and rank 2, random 16: model.time_pool=2, model.input_dropout=0.3, model.proj_dim=512, model.activation="relu", model.pooling="meanmax", model.classifier_hidden=128, model.dropout=0.1, features.normalization="utterance", augment.time_masks=4, augment.time_mask_width=20, train.lr=0.001, train.crop_s=4.0, train.label_smoothing=0.0, train.class_balance="none", train.epochs=30 (9641b0d38f33, 0.7843), as the variant; seeds 6 to 10, which no screen used. The record is the one with the higher mean validation UA over these seeds, chosen before any test file is read. How the results are read is fixed in RULE_night29.txt (analyses/night29_prep_20261028) before any run. Priority 150.
